description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 29.01.2018 to 04.02.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and other charges will be calculated based on currency exchange rates. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it establishes compliance requirements for customs payments and rescinds previous regulations.
